title: Simple Harmonic Oscillator
description: An undriven, undamped dynamical model with a linear restoring force proportional to displacement from a stable equilibrium. Its nonzero motions are sinusoidal with an amplitude-independent frequency.

relations.note: For a constant mass acted on by a linear restoring force.
Each positive-frequency undamped linear normal coordinate obeys an independent harmonic-oscillator equation.
Approximates planar pendulum librations only at small angular amplitude.
